notes: The baseline class trainer cooldowns (three minutes or longer, no talent needed) each spec guide's Cooldowns list shows, by spec key. A cooldown the spec's rotation casts is listed from the rotation already, and a talent cooldown is listed only when the guide's own build takes the talent, so neither belongs here. Anything not named here (a stun, a taunt the spec never presses, a spell another race or spec uses) stays off the list. The class lane owns its own rows; web/src/lib/guides/rotation-lists.test.ts checks every name is a trainer spell the class learns by level 60.
